将其他 AI 应用的配置、项目和聊天导入 MiniCode: Bring setup, projects, and chats from other AI apps into MiniCode
自动同步已连接来源中新增和更新的内容: Automatically sync new and updated content from connected sources
管理来自配置和已启用插件的生命周期钩子。: Manage lifecycle hooks from config and enabled plugins.
钩子在沙箱外运行，可能不安全。: Hooks run outside of the sandbox and may be unsafe.
MiniCode 创建托管工作树的目录。留空则使用默认位置。: Directory where MiniCode creates managed worktrees. Leave blank to use the default location.
创建工作树前始终获取上游更新: Always fetch upstream before creating worktrees
通常会在常规 Git 操作中获取分支更新。开启后还会在每次新建工作树前获取。: MiniCode normally picks up branch updates during regular Git activity. This also fetches before each new worktree.
建议保持开启，以免旧工作树占用不必要的磁盘空间。: Recommended for most users. Turn this off only if you want to manage old worktrees and disk usage yourself.
关闭后，MiniCode 将停止自动清理旧工作树，需要自行管理磁盘空间。: MiniCode will stop deleting old worktrees automatically. You will need to manage their disk usage yourself.
保留的托管工作树数量。删除前会保存快照，以便恢复。: Number of managed worktrees to keep before older ones are pruned. MiniCode snapshots worktrees before deleting so they can be restored.
MiniCode 创建的工作树将显示在这里。: Worktrees created by MiniCode will appear here.
这将永久删除 {count} 个聊天及其子智能体，无法撤销。: This permanently deletes {count} chats and their subagents. This cannot be undone.
已删除：{deleted}。已变化并跳过：{skipped}。未完成：{fail: Chats deleted: {deleted}. Changed chats skipped: {skipped}. Incomplete deletions: {failed}.
管理保存在这台电脑上的聊天和工作树。: Manage chats and worktrees stored on this computer.
永久删除前，先查看聊天及其子智能体。: Review chats and their subagents before permanently deleting them.
查看工作副本，并选择保留多少个旧工作树。: Review working copies and choose how many old worktrees to keep.
恢复或删除单个已归档聊天。: Restore or delete individual archived chats.
大小包含子智能体。删除聊天及其子智能体将永久生效。: Sizes include subagents. Deleting a chat and its subagents is permanent.
为新聊天配置权限、网络访问和智能体回复。: Configure permissions, web access, and agent responses for new chats.
选择 MiniCode 何时请求批准。: Choose when MiniCode asks for approval.
允许工作区写入沙箱访问网络。: Allow network access when the sandbox is set to workspace write.
选择 MiniCode 在回复中包含多少细节。: Choose how much detail MiniCode includes in responses.
选择 MiniCode 如何概述推理过程。: Choose how MiniCode summarizes its reasoning.
选择 MiniCode 运行命令时的访问范围。: Choose how much MiniCode can do when running commands.
选择 MiniCode 如何访问网页。: Choose how MiniCode accesses the web.
聊天拥有环境后即可查看文件。: Files will be available when the chat has an environment.
从左边缘调整设备视口: Resize device viewport from the left edge
从右边缘调整设备视口: Resize device viewport from the right edge
从下边缘调整设备视口: Resize device viewport from the bottom edge
从左下角调整设备视口: Resize device viewport from the bottom-left corner
从右下角调整设备视口: Resize device viewport from the bottom-right corner
选择数字快捷键优先切换聊天或标签页。: Choose whether primary number shortcuts select chats or tabs.
在默认浏览器中打开网页链接: Open web link in default browser
按住指定按键并点击网页链接，即可在系统默认浏览器中打开。: Hold the assigned keys while clicking a web link to open it in your default system browser.
